description: This file contains implementation of a priority queue data structure with functions for insertion, removal, and manipulation, tailored for different comparison strategies.

methods.name: int compare(struct prio_queue * queue,size_t i,size_t j)
methods.description: Inline comparison function for queue elements based on custom comparator and counters.

methods.name: void swap(struct prio_queue * queue,size_t i,size_t j)
methods.description: Inline function to swap two elements in the priority queue array.

methods.name: void prio_queue_reverse(struct prio_queue * queue)
methods.description: Reverses the order of elements in the queue; only for LIFO queues.

methods.name: void clear_prio_queue(struct prio_queue * queue)
methods.description: Clears all elements and resets the priority queue.

methods.name: void prio_queue_put(struct prio_queue * queue,void * thing)
methods.description: Inserts a new element into the priority queue, maintaining the heap property.

methods.name: void sift_down_root(struct prio_queue * queue)
methods.description: Maintains the heap property after removal, pushing down the root element.

methods.name: void * prio_queue_get(struct prio_queue * queue)
methods.description: Retrieves and removes the highest priority element from the queue.

methods.name: void * prio_queue_peek(struct prio_queue * queue)
methods.description: Returns the highest priority element without removing it.

methods.name: void prio_queue_replace(struct prio_queue * queue,void * thing)
methods.description: Replaces the top element or appends if empty, maintaining the priority queue.

ctags.name: compare
ctags.pattern: /^static inline int compare(struct prio_queue *queue, size_t i, size_t j)$/

ctags.name: swap
ctags.pattern: /^static inline void swap(struct prio_queue *queue, size_t i, size_t j)$/
